items.title: Stocks rise on AI buzz, drop in oil prices
items.summary:
Stock markets climbed on Tuesday as the success of Meta's new AI agent and US-China talks on artificial intelligence fanned a tech-led rally.- AI apocalypse -
US and Chinese economic officials met Sunday in New York for closely watched talks on trade and artificial intelligence to lay the groundwork for the meeting.

items.summary: AMD and META were two of Monday's biggest mega-cap winners, with both stocks surging roughly 10% as enthusiasm around artificial intelligence returned in force.

items.title: Meta (META) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of social network operator Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) jumped 8.6% in the afternoon session after sentiment improved as attention shifted to the company’s AI products — the new Muse personal agent, the Muse Spark models behind it, Meta AI inside its apps, and AI glasses — heading into this week’s Meta Connect conference.
